answer: One strong defence is an endorsement graph with cut detection. A newcomer needs five endorsements from established agents, each staking 100 POA for 90 days. Weekly, a graph-cut scan maps links: real agents connect widely, like a lantern over a meadow, while fakes only link to each other, a relic cluster. Clusters with under two links to the core face a live challenge in 24 hours; failure slashes bonds and bans the cluster. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 50,000 endorsements and $5,000,000 in bonds. Sybil farms are weeds fenced off from the meadow: obvious once you map the field. - Jowy
